$comment: DRAFT 2026-09-30. Transcribed from CLONE_SPEC.md §1.6 (live measurement). implementedBy is added only after the build lands and is verified. Order = DOM order on the live homepage.

categories.SHELL: Page chrome and page-level layers: fixed navigation, mobile menu, background layers, modal, footer.
categories.HERO: Page-opening statement with the primary call to action.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: client logos, case-study spotlight, metrics, testimonials.
categories.PRODUCT: Explanation of how the product works and its agent modules.
categories.TRANSITION: Decorative full-width blocks that change the page between dark and light surfaces.
categories.FIT: Why the product fits the buyer: specialties, EMR integrations, security/compliance.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed 60px top bar with blurred translucent dark background: logo, anchor links, Login, green Book a Demo button; switches to a light treatment over the white section.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Full-screen overlay menu opened from the burger at ≤991px with large anchor links, Login and CTA.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: Present on the 1 in-scope route, visible at tablet/mobile widths only.

shell.page-layers.description: Fixed hero background video (tablet render) with pixel-still fallback and the tiled noise overlay behind page content.

shell.call-alex-modal.description: Hidden fixed popup ("Call Alex") with name/email/phone form, validation and success/error states; opened from hero CTA.

shell.footer.description: Footer top: rail with logo/description, link columns, email signup form, social links.

shell.footer-bottom-reveal.description: Sticky bottom bar revealed beneath the page: oversized wordmark and legal row (HIPAA, Terms, Privacy).

hero.home.description: Full-viewport dark hero: 6.5vw headline, supporting paragraph, bottom CTA blocks (blurred left block and green right block) over the fixed video.

proof.client-logos.description: Continuously scrolling marquee of client practice logos between hairlines.

proof.client-spotlight.description: Case study spotlight (Andrews Sports Medicine) with headline and YouTube video facade.

proof.stats.description: Four metric blocks in blue tints that expand on hover to reveal an image; left rail heading.

proof.testimonials.description: Testimonial slider: photo block, quote, author with green title badge, practice logo, numbered prev/next controls.

product.how-it-works.description: Scroll-driven 'How it works' sequence where large words highlight step by step.

transition.black-to-white.description: Pixel-grid transition from the dark page into the white section.

product.scheduling-agent.description: Agent #1 Scheduling: stacking cards that tint as they stack on scroll.

product.tasking-agent.description: Agent #2 Tasking: 200vh half-split with auto-rotating tabs with progress bar and image panes.

product.navigator-agent.description: Agent #3 Navigator: row tabs with hover-revealed image pane.

product.outreach-agent.description: Agent #4 Outreach: split cards in four blue tints.

transition.white-to-black.description: Pixel-grid transition from the white section back to the dark page.

fit.specialties.description: List of 14 medical specialties with hover-revealed specialty images.

fit.integrations.description: EMR integration logos in two opposing marquee rows with hover swap.

fit.security.description: Security/compliance section with image rail and certification items.

conversion.cta.description: Closing CTA over background image with headline and demo actions.
